mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_message (id, tenant_id, conversation_id, run_id, sequence_no, role, content, message_status) values (#{e.id}, #{e.tenantId}, #{e.conversationId}, #{e.runId}, #{e.sequenceNo}, #{e.role}, #{e.content}, #{e.messageStatus})
mapper.select: select id, tenant_id, conversation_id, run_id, sequence_no, role, content, message_status, citations, create_time, update_time from ai_agent_message where run_id = #{runId} and role = 'assistant'
mapper.update: update ai_agent_message set content = #{content}, message_status = #{status}, citations = #{citations,typeHandler=org.etd.ai.agent.mapper.typehandler.AgentCitationTypeHandler}, update_time = current_timestamp where run_id = #{runId} and role = 'assistant' and message_status = 'generating'
